question: Does recorded order sales amount reconcile to subtotal minus discount plus delivery fee plus GST for 2025? For each order status, give the count of non-zero differences and their signed sum in INR; do not assume one side is the corrected amount.

action.query:
SELECT 
  ob.ORDER_STATUS,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN ABS(of.SALES_AMOUNT - (of.SUBTOTAL - of.DISCOUNT + of.DELIVERY_FEE + of.GST)) > 0 THEN 1 END) AS nonzero_difference_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(of.SALES_AMOUNT - (of.SUBTOTAL - of.DISCOUNT + of.DELIVERY_FEE + of.GST)) > 0 THEN (of.SALES_AMOUNT - (of.SUBTOTAL - of.DISCOUNT + of.DELIVERY_FEE + of.GST)) ELSE 0 END) AS signed_difference_sum_inr
FROM ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_BASE ob
JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_FINANCIALS of ON ob.ORDER_ID = of.ORDER_ID
WHERE ob.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ob.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01' AND ob.CURRENCY = 'INR'
GROUP BY ob.ORDER_STATUS
ORDER BY ob.ORDER_STATUS;
